lines.say: Your grandma left you two things. Her debt. And a key.
Forty thousand dollars of debt. Sixty years of it.
The key has a tag. Nine F. The empty flat nobody opens.
Inside, boxes of letters. Thank-you notes. Hundreds.
Every loan paid someone’s rent in this building. Doris. The guard. Your mom. For sixty years.
Would you pay off her debt? Write it in the comments.
